title: Welcome to the HPC-DAT community forum
body:
This forum is a place for researchers to ask practical questions, share scalable workflows, propose ideas, and follow HPC-DAT news.

Before posting, choose the topic that best fits your contribution. Use **Questions and Help** for questions that can have an accepted answer, **Ideas and Feedback** for suggestions, and **Use Cases and Showcases** for workflows or results.

Please follow our [Code of Conduct](https://github.com/HPC-DAT/forum/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md). Include enough context for others to reproduce a technical problem, but never post credentials, access tokens, private data, or sensitive cluster information.
